summary: Preserve verified tenant release placement through browser session authentication so Cloud administration can issue release-aware identities.
userImpact: Tenant administrators can open Cloud Releases and managed engine controls after signing in.
security: Session authentication still checks tenant membership and now rejects stale routed placement while retaining only server-verified release assertion metadata.
documentation: The release note records the authentication-context fix and its targeted regression checks.
rollback: Redeploy the previous OSS host release if needed; no tenant data rollback is involved.
validation: Run pooled tenant authentication and placement middleware regression tests, package checks, and the protected CI gate.
